tfimpact: 1 change destroys data, 1 change widens exposure, 1 change interrupts service, 38 routine
Plan: 1 to add, 40 to change, 1 to destroy (1 replacement, 6 unchanged). Terraform/OpenTofu 1.15.5 · 47 resources.

CRITICAL (2)
  * aws_dynamodb_table.sessions will be destroyed and recreated; every item in the table is lost [PLAN-DATA-002]
    The DynamoDB table is replaced because hash_key ("session_id" → "user_id") cannot be changed in place. Deletion protection is off; point-in-time recovery is off, so there is no automatic backup to restore from.
    -> If the change is intended, take a snapshot or backup first and plan the cutover. If the replacement is a surprise, revert hash_key. lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } makes Terraform refuse a plan like this.
  * aws_security_group.bastion opens SSH to the internet [PLAN-NET-001]
    The security group gains ingress for tcp port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0.
    -> Restrict the source to known CIDR ranges or a security group. If public access is intended, limit it to the listening port and say so in the change.

HIGH (1)
  * aws_instance.bastion: changing user_data in place has a service effect [PLAN-DISRUPT-001]
    user_data changes (value hidden): the instance is stopped and started to apply the new user data (user_data_replace_on_change is false); it keeps its ID but gets a new public IP unless it has an Elastic IP, and the script only re-runs if the AMI's cloud-init is configured to.
    -> Apply in a maintenance window or confirm that clients tolerate the interruption.

  * 10 x aws_cloudwatch_log_group: retention_in_days 30 → 90
  * aws_lb.public: subnet_mapping, subnets
